script: experiments/storm_wind_calibration.py (written after this file is committed)
status: registered before the parametric model has been evaluated at any SYNOP station; the QC run (80f43aa) looked at observed storm-window maxima only (obs side, no model)
question: Does a multiplicative correction of the best-track parametric site-wind model (core.storm_advisory.site_exposure) fitted on 4TA SYNOP 10-min mean wind reduce its error on held-out storms at open-sea stations?

inputs.track_merge: experiments/storm_hindcast.load_tracks (WP file, last3years replaces same SID)
inputs.obs_qc: experiments/synop_qc_hpqn.json wind_qc_rule (commit 80f43aa): wspd_valid = not NaN, <= 60, not spike

model.function: core.storm_advisory.site_exposure, unchanged: TOKYO > HKO > USA x 0.93 > CMA intensity; wind radii (lower bound) else modified Rankine alpha 0.5, RMW USA_RMW or 30 nmi, capped at 34 kt x 0.93 outside R34

stations.headline_group: open_sea (closest analogue to an open-water cage); other groups get their own fitted factor, reported on test but not in the verdict

storms: IBTrACS SEASON 2000-2025 whose 30-min track comes within 300 km of the station; obs and track times must be <= 2025-12-04 (end of SYNOP)

pairing.rule: valid obs times (obs_utc) inside the passage window, each matched to the nearest densified track row within 15 min that is itself within 300 km; the model is evaluated at those times only
pairing.unit: passage = (storm, station); obs_max = max obs over paired times; model_max = max model over the SAME paired times
pairing.eligible: n_pairs >= 2 and a paired obs within +-3 h of the continuous-track model peak and model_max > 0

split.test: SEASON 2020-2025 (contains YAGI 2024; Co To 8/day from 06/2020, Hon Dau 8/day 2023-2024)
split.model_selection: leave-one-season-out CV inside train, open_sea passages

variants.C1: single factor k: obs ~ k * model, k = argmin sum |obs - k model| (experiments.synop_storm.fit_factor) on train open_sea
variants.C2: two distance bands by passage min_dist_km: k_near (<= 100 km), k_far (> 100 km), each fitted as C1
variants.selection_rule: selected = C2 if CV-MAE(C2) < 0.95 * CV-MAE(C1), else C1; decided on train only, before the test set is scored

metrics.primary: MAE (m/s) of passage max wind, test open_sea passages, selected vs C0
secondary: bias (model - obs) and MAE by distance band of min_dist_km (0-50, 50-100, 100-200, 200-300) and storm intensity class at closest approach (Beaufort lt8, 8-11, ge12)
the same split by exposure_method at model_max (wind_radii = lower bound, censored; rankine; rankine_capped_by_r34)
tiers from the default storm_wind thresholds (Beaufort 6/8/10/12 -> tier 1-4) on obs vs model Beaufort: exact tier agreement, POD and FAR for obs >= Beaufort 8 and >= 10
per-storm sign test (test, open_sea): storm mean |error| selected vs C0
coastal / sheltered: group and per-station factors fitted on train, MAE on test (descriptive)

helps_criterion.H2: storm-cluster bootstrap (resample test SIDs with replacement, 2000 reps, seed 20261104): 95th percentile of MAE(selected) - MAE(C0) < 0
helps_criterion.H3: test exact tier agreement(selected) >= C0, and POD(obs >= Beaufort 8)(selected) >= C0 when the test set has any obs >= Beaufort 8
helps_criterion.verdict: helps = H1 and H2 and H3; suggestive = H1 and H3 without H2; does_not_help otherwise

expected_small_n: test open_sea passages are expected in the tens, with only a handful at Beaufort >= 8 (Yagi dominates); the verdict is about the bulk of passages, not about extreme storms

outputs_if_helps.code_constant_proposal: a site-wind multiplier (or two by distance) for the parametric path (storm_hindcast, hazard_runner_replay --wind-source best_track), written in the artifact and RL only; core/ is not changed
outputs_if_helps.alert_config_proposal: only when helps: thresholds T_i' = beaufort(BEAUFORT_LOWER_MS[L_i] / k) for L_i in 6/8/10/12 (k = selected factor, k_near if C2), clipped to the storm_wind guardrails; a schema-2 copy of config/alert_tiers.default.json with config_version proposal-hzcal-20261104 is written to the artifact dir only (never runtime/alert-config/), and only if at least one threshold changes. Its note says it applies to the parametric best-track wind, not to Open-Meteo forecast wind

not_claimed: best track is a post-analysis oracle: no forecast skill
SYNOP stations are land / island sites, not cages
licence of 4TA unconfirmed: no SYNOP numbers in paper drafts
